about: What a usable part of a clip may show (user 2026-11-10: sorting the B-roll by content). A newsroom changes this list, not the code: code is the label's id, text the dictionary key of its name, prompt what the model is asked in English (the model was trained on English captions). A part gets the labels whose share among the labels of what a picture shows (softmax of the model's logits) reaches least. A statement label (statement: true) is no group: a part whose own score for it reaches statement_least is a statement, not B-roll.
